title: How Does Photosynthesis Work?
paragraphs: Plants make their own food. They do this with light from the sun. This is called photosynthesis.
A plant needs three things. It takes water from the soil. It takes air through small holes in its leaves. And it needs sunlight.
Inside the leaf, there are tiny green parts. They catch the light. Then the plant makes sugar. The sugar gives the plant energy to grow.
The plant also makes oxygen. It lets the oxygen go into the air. We need this oxygen to breathe. So plants help us live.

questions.q: What do plants make with light?
Where does the plant take water from?

questions.a: They make oxygen for us to breathe.
